title: OpenVX 1.3.2 Released: More Precise Errors, Better Consistency, and Groundwork for 2.0
subtitle: Khronos released OpenVX 1.3.2, an update to the open, royalty-free standard that uses a high-level graph-based framework to deliver portable, efficient vision processing. This focused update strengthens error handling, improves conformance, and makes OpenVX easier for vendors to implement and for developers to debug — laying the groundwork for the next major release, OpenVX 2.0.
